content_blocks.title: Component Caching with <KeepAlive>: Component communication
content_blocks.alt_text: Component communication diagram for lesson 101: Component Caching with <KeepAlive>. Parent owns the value or business intent → Child receives data and renders its view → Child emits intent; parent decides updates
content_blocks.caption: Component flow: data moves into children through props; emitted events communicate requested changes back to the owner.

task_acceptance_criteria: The example demonstrates the named Vue concept rather than only mentioning it.
